links.outcome: Clinical documentation time, consultation time, documentation quality, GP and patient experience after ambient scribe
links.effect: Documentation time decreased by 42.7 seconds (95% CI -56.29 to -30.78, p<0.0001); total consultation time not different (-61.4 s, p=0.069); GPs reported reduced workload; inaccurate summaries noted.
links.quote: Clinical documentation time decreased by 42.7 seconds (95% CI [-56.29; - 30.78], p<0.0001).

screen.reason: Prospective before-after study of an ambient AI scribe deployed in primary care consultations, assessing documentation time, patient and GP experiences, and unintended consequences.
